headline: Telmex Insists the Company "No Longer Has a Business"; STRM Refutes and Accuses It of Attempting Dismantling
summary: Telmex management said the company is no longer a viable business. Union leader Francisco Hernández Juárez said the STRM has documents showing Telmex is recovering and accused the company of seeking to dismantle it.
why: Telmex is Mexico's dominant fixed-line telecom operator, and labour and restructuring disputes can affect its costs, service and strategic options.
original_headline: Telmex insiste que la empresa "ya no es negocio"; el STRM refuta y acusa intento de desmantelamiento
